transcript.content: Hello, what brings you in today?

I came in because... well, I just can't stop feeling like everything that goes wrong is my fault. It's like I'm a terrible employee and a bad homeowner, and I just deserve to lose everything I've worked so hard for.
Did these feelings begin after a specific stressful event or major change in your life?

Yeah, I think so. It's been going on for about two years and three months now. It started right after I bought my townhouse... the pressure of keeping it just really began to build, and I've felt this way ever since.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about many different areas of your life, not just your townhouse?

No, not really. It's mostly just the townhouse and work. I mean, I don't sit around worrying about my health or the news or anything like that. It's just this overwhelming feeling that I'm failing at my job and failing at taking care of my home, and that it's all my fault.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities that you normally enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I used to do a lot of different things... like, I'd plan brunches, paint in the spare room, go hiking, and I used to sign up for networking events. But now, I don't know... doing any of that just feels like another chore. It's like they're just tasks I'm pretending to care about.
Over the past two years, have you felt depressed or down more days than not?

Yeah, definitely. Looking back on it... the low mood and that loss of interest have been there for almost the whole time since this started. I mean, there have been a few brief periods where I felt like I could function a little better, but for the most part, it's been pretty constant.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking energy during this period?

No, I wouldn't say I've felt unusually tired. I mean, I'm just as tired as anyone else who works full time, I guess, but it's not like I don't have the physical energy to do things. It's more of a mental block. I just don't want to do them.
During this period, have you had difficulty concentrating or making decisions?

No, I haven't really noticed any problems with that. I mean, my job involves a lot of organizing and analyzing data, and I'm still able to focus on my work and make decisions just fine. It's not the concentration that's the issue, it's just... the motivation to actually care about what I'm doing.
During this period, have you had any changes in your sleep, such as trouble sleeping or sleeping much more than usual?

Yeah, sleep has been a big issue. Most nights I just lie awake for hours... I end up just listening to the house settle. And even when I do fall asleep, I almost always wake up around three or four in the morning. After that, I just can't get back to sleep before my alarm goes off for work.
During these past two years, has there been a period of at least two months when you felt neither depressed nor uninterested in things?

No, definitely not two months. Looking back on it, the low mood and just... not caring about anything have been there for almost the whole two years since this started. There have been maybe a few brief periods where I felt a little lighter and could function a little better, but they never lasted long. It's mostly just been a constant weight.
